summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) member to ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title). rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, with no Windows calls. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch that calls term.set_title with the control's second item. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on sys.platform == "win32"), test_control_title, and test_control_set_window_title. Tests and Black were not run, per instructions, and nothing is committed. The legacy-Windows skip uses sys.platform as a proxy for legacy detection, and the changelog URL was inferred from the spec.
